Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We operate beyond organizational silos, combining deep expertise in data engineering and AI-driven solutions to design and deliver scalable, user-centric applications and modern data architectures. We support a wide range of industries, including Automotive, Banking, Insurance, Telecommunications, E-commerce, and Public Services.
We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and operate secure, production-grade AI solutions on Microsoft Azure. The role combines strong software engineering with Generative AI, agentic workflows, enterprise integration, evaluation, and cloud-native delivery. The focus is on taking AI solutions from prototype to reliable production use, rather than working exclusively on prompts or model experimentation.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design and develop Generative AI and agentic solutions using Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI.
Build orchestration workflows, backend services, and reusable AI components using Python, Azure Functions, and Durable Functions.
Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation solutions using enterprise knowledge sources, embeddings, vector search, reranking, grounding, and citations.
Integrate AI solutions with REST APIs, databases, document repositories, business applications, and external tools.
Develop document-processing and information-extraction workflows using OCR and Azure AI Document Intelligence.
Implement secure Azure architectures using private connectivity, managed identities, secrets management, least-privilege access, and enterprise networking standards.
Define evaluation datasets, quality metrics, regression tests, and release criteria covering groundedness, relevance, hallucination, safety, latency, and cost.
Establish CI/CD, automated testing, source-control, monitoring, tracing, and deployment practices using Azure DevOps and GitHub.
Collaborate with architects, domain experts, product teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Produce technical documentation, contribute to reusable engineering standards, and support knowledge transfer and production operations.
 What you'll bring along 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of professional software, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of production AI or machine-learning solutions.
Strong Python development skills and sound software-engineering practices covering modular design, automated testing, asynchronous processing, APIs, and resilient services.
Hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, Durable Functions, Azure Storage or Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Search.
Production experience with LLM-based applications, RAG, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and agent orchestration.
Experience integrating AI applications with REST APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and structured and unstructured data sources.
Experience with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, observability, secure cloud architecture, and production troubleshooting.
Strong understanding of AI evaluation, grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt-injection protection, PII handling, guardrails, human oversight, and Responsible AI.
Experience with document intelligence, OCR, multimodal AI, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, or comparable orchestration frameworks is considered a plus.
Microsoft Azure AI or cloud certifications and experience in regulated enterprise environments are considered a plus.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills.
Excellent command of both spoken and written English.
